text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, entire items visible, realistic materials. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger, stand, typography, logos or watermark. One dark burgundy matte satin-grosgrain fabric hair bow with a small central knot, two soft loops and two long ribbon tails cut diagonally, a concealed simple hair clip on the reverse.
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reference image defines CLOTHING AND ACCESSORY DESIGN ONLY. Create one photorealistic wardrobe library product image on a pure white seamless background, vertical 2:3. NO person, no face, no hair, no skin, no body parts, no visible mannequin, no hanger, no display stand, no typography or watermark. Soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric/metal textures, subtle contact shadows, full item uncropped with breathing room. Faithfully retain the reference garment design rather than redesigning it. Extract ONLY the dark burgundy long-tail hair bow visible in the reference. One single wearable dark wine-red fabric ribbon bow, two soft full loops, small center knot and two long loose ribbon tails cut diagonally, subtle matte satin/grosgrain fabric texture rather than glossy plastic. Show front three-quarter product view, bow center near upper third and tails naturally falling below; complete bow and tail tips visible. No hair, head, earrings or clothing. The hidden back attachment can remain unseen; do not invent decoration, jewels or extra layers.
reproduction_note: 依据用户提供造型图整理为纯白背景无人服装、独立配饰与完整造型。小尺寸耳饰和吊坠细节、头发遮挡部分保守补全；不作精确款号或品牌鉴定。需保持设计时结合原参考，不承诺纯文字逐像素复现。
